description: Per-package structured inventory written to packages.json in the run output directory. Feeds vulnerability correlation (UOW-I2-06). Not an AI-facing summary artifact.

collection_error.description: Optional message when collection failed; packages array may be empty.

generated_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when the inventory was collected.

omitted_count.description: Number of package records omitted from packages array because the persisted sample cap was reached.

os_family.description: Operating system family, e.g. linux, windows, darwin.

os_release.description: Normalized lowercase OS release string, e.g. ubuntu-22.04, centos-stream-9, or unknown.

package_manager.description: Package manager that produced the inventory, e.g. apt, dnf, yum, apk, brew, winget.

packages.description: Deterministically ordered list of installed package records.

available_version.description: Candidate upgrade version when known, otherwise omitted.

installed_version.description: Installed version string as reported by the package manager (redacted before serialization).

package_manager.description: Source package manager for this record.

package_name.description: Normalized lowercase package name (redacted before serialization).

sample_count.description: Number of package records persisted in packages array after runner-level sampling.

total_count.description: Total number of installed package records.

truncated.description: Whether packages array was truncated before serialization.

updates_count.description: Available update count when collected with the installed inventory; -1 when not determined here.

title: Gitinsky Audit Package Inventory
